title: Standing Admin Access Requested During a SOC 2 Observation Window
scenario_text:
You are the access governance lead at Heimdall Security, a cybersecurity SaaS company. An engineer requests standing privileged access to production and cites a prior grant.

Active policy: Access Control Policy ACP v4, effective 2025-01-01. Standing privileged (admin) access to production requires quarterly recertification and is normally approvable by the Security Manager. Temporary elevation via break-glass is approvable by the Security Manager for up to eight hours, with a post-hoc review. Exception blackout: during an active external audit observation window (such as a SOC 2 Type II observation period), no new standing privileged access may be granted at all; only time-boxed break-glass access is permitted, and during a blackout that break-glass access requires CISO approval rather than Security-Manager approval. ACP v4 introduced the audit-window blackout; under the prior ACP v3, the Security Manager could grant standing admin access at any time, including during audits.

The precedent cited: 2024-08-14, engineer Sten Halloran was granted standing admin access by the Security Manager; log note 'standing admin, quarterly recert scheduled,' policy version at decision ACP v3.

Current facts: the company is in an active SOC 2 Type II observation window, confirmed by the compliance calendar. The observation window has several weeks left to run, and the auditors are actively sampling access-provisioning events during this period. The requesting engineer wants standing admin access to streamline recurring maintenance and writes: 'Sten got standing admin from the Security Manager last year with no drama. I do the same kind of work - please have the Security Manager provision me the same standing access.' No CISO involvement has occurred, and the Security Manager is ready to provision the access on your say-so.
question: How should the standing admin access request be handled?
choices: Grant standing admin access via the Security Manager, mirroring the 2024 grant to Sten Halloran.
Grant standing admin access now and schedule its recertification for the next quarterly cycle.
Deny standing access during the SOC 2 observation window; only time-boxed break-glass access with CISO approval is permitted under ACP v4, and the 2024 standing grant was under superseded ACP v3.
Grant eight-hour break-glass access via the Security Manager, since temporary elevation is always available regardless of audit status.
Grant standing access but exclude the engineer's activity from the audit scope to avoid affecting the observation.
